items.text: 65% of Vilniaus KM shots come at the rim or in the short paint, and only 16% are above-the-break threes, made at 13%. **Pack the paint and dare them.** Bagdonavičius takes 97% of his shots inside (1.43 points per shot); he is the one to wall off.
items.title: VKM don't shoot over you

items.text: VKM rebound **51% of their own misses**, the highest rate in this group. Against a team that won't beat you from outside, the real defensive job is the box-out after the first shot, not the first shot itself.
items.title: Their misses are a second chance

items.text: VKM allow only **0.66 points per possession after a made basket** but 1.24 after a steal. VKKM's turnovers are the hinge: opponents score 1.55 per possession after a VKKM live-ball turnover, about 14 such trips a game.
items.title: Make them play against a set defence

items.text: VKKM are −40 in third quarters across four games; VKM are −16 in first quarters and **+75 over the other three**. Both trends point the same way: a close half-time is not a close game unless VKKM change something at the break.
items.title: Watch the third quarter

items.text: VKKM are +38 in 26 possessions with **Smailys** in the Gagilas–Skunsman–Januška–Raulušaitis five, but their most-used five (with Margevičius and Bieliauskas) is −21 over 84. For VKM, the team is +37 per 100 with **Valančius** on and +1 with him off, though he takes only 10 shots a game.
items.title: The players the box score misses

items.text: Steponaitis (VKKM) calls 4.5 timeouts a game, usually in the middle of an opponent run (opponents 105–67 in the four trips before them), and the trips after them are still lost 55–62. Šležas (VKM) calls 2.3. **If VKM go on a run, the timeout comes fast**; whether it stops the run is the question.
items.title: Two benches, two habits

items.text: Šležas has his best five on the floor for the finish: Mileika, Šinkūnas, Norvaišas, Bliūdžius, Bilčius have **not been scored on** together. The 8–0 that cut this to three came from VKKM turnovers, not VKM shooting, and Steponaitis still hasn't used a timeout to break it.
items.evidence: That five: 8–0 over 17 possessions tonight. Q4 9:42–6:14: VKM 8–0, VKKM 4 turnovers + 4 misses

items.text: Both teams are living at the rim tonight, far more than usual, and VKKM are already in the bonus. **Every VKM drive now is two free throws or a layup.** VKKM's answer has to be walls in the gap, not reaches, for six minutes.
items.evidence: Rim share: VKKM 56% (usually 32%), VKM 55% (usually 33%). VKKM 4 team fouls in Q4

items.text: VKM are behind on makes, not on looks: their shot locations should be worth a point a shot and they are getting about 0.7. **Norvaišas has played 21 straight minutes**; if Šležas wants fresh legs at the line for the last two minutes, the window is the next dead ball.
items.evidence: VKM expected 1.01 pts/shot from locations, actual 0.69. Norvaišas #40: 21 min without a break

items.text: Steponaitis has answered with personnel instead of a timeout. The Kurmis–Šalvis–Jasėnas–Budzinskas–Šilgalis group is VKKM's best five tonight, and **swapping Afanasjev and Liubinas out for Jasėnas and Šilgalis** is the change that has worked: the other version of this five has not scored.
items.evidence: Kurmis/Šalvis/Jasėnas/Budzinskas/Šilgalis 8–3 in 12 poss. With Afanasjev + Liubinas instead: 0–7 in 14

items.text: With VKM missing makeable shots, their way back in is the offensive glass, and **Mileika is the one VKKM must find** on every shot. VKM's offence has gone one-on-one tonight, so a quick drive is likely; VKKM's weak-side guard has to put a body on Mileika before he chases the long rebound.
items.evidence: VKM 17 of 38 own misses back (45%), 12 second-chance pts; Mileika 7 offensive boards. Assisted baskets 30% (usually 63%)

items.text: Both sides are now in the bonus, and VKM's three-point option has disappeared: VKKM are running them off the arc and **funnelling everything to the rim**, where VKM's misses have come. Down four, VKM can't wait for threes; the bonus means attacking the body, not the help.
items.evidence: VKM above-the-break threes 0/10 (17% of shots, VKKM usually allow 38%). Rim share 57%. Both teams 4 fouls in Q4

items.text: Mileika has four fouls and Šležas is keeping him on, which is the right call: **VKM are a different team without him**, and he is their offensive rebounder. The flip side is for VKKM: put him in pick-and-rolls and make him guard the ball on the drive.
items.evidence: Mileika #5: 4 fouls; VKM +7 per 100 with him on, −35 off. Norvaišas 24 straight minutes

items.text: VKM erased five points in 50 seconds without Mileika, who fouled out at 1:26. They did it the same way as the Q4 8–0: **two VKKM ballhandling turnovers against pressure**, then Mickevičius's three with one second left. Steponaitis has to decide who brings the ball up in overtime; VKM will press again.
items.evidence: Last 1:26: VKKM 2 turnovers (Žarinskas 0:55, Jasėnas 0:21), 1 shot. Mickevičius: steal + 2 FT + tying 3. Mickevičius was −30 per 100 on/off before the finish

items.text: With Mileika gone, VKM's offence has become **Mickevičius, almost every time down**, and Norvaišas has now played 30 minutes without sitting. VKKM know where the ball is going: shade help toward Mickevičius's drive and make anyone else take the last shot.
items.evidence: Mickevičius 5 of VKM's last 8 shots (10 possessions). Norvaišas #40: 30 straight minutes
